directions.SE:
Use case: identity-preserve. Make an actual six-frame Idle animation sprite strip, one fixed direction only, not a turnaround.
Reference1: authoritative FRONT Idle strip for SAME protagonist identity, adult7.5head proportions, same outfit, delicate brown fine linework and pale warm cel shading. Reference2: orientation and backside clothing construction only, IGNORE the background artifacts entirely.
DIRECTION: FRONT THREE-QUARTER facing VIEWER RIGHT, body and nose both point diagonally right. Both eyes visible. Match top row second figure of reference2.
Every frame has this EXACT SAME orientation, no gradual turning. Same ordinary adult male with short darkbrown tousled hair, slim average adult build, ivory open collar rolled-sleeve shirt, graybrown vest, brown trousers belt laceup shoes, tied brown pouch on anatomical LEFT hip (follow actual rotation, never move it to right hip). Empty hands relaxed down. No book.
Draw EXACTLY SIX whole-body frames in ONE HORIZONTAL ROW of six equal grid cells. Fixed scale, camera and foot baseline. Match reference1 character head/body ratio and painting exactly. Do not enlarge head, make chibi or add details. Same garment construction and folds from frame to frame. Clean precise silhouette.
Frames:1 exhale neutral eyesopen;2 slightinhale chest/shouldersrise1-2pixels;3 peakinhale halfblink;4 peakinhale fullblink;5 relax shoulders, eyesreopening;6 exhale identical toframe1. For rear views with eyes hidden, keep eyes invisible and express only tiny breathing in shoulders, hair tips and shirt. For front/profile show a small blink naturally. Feet, pelvis and hands stay still, NO stepping, no hand gestures, no bobbing entirebody. Maintain same shoe shapes and exact planted foot positions. Continuous quiet breathing, not six independent poses.
Landscape six-cell strip. Plenty of transparent margin around complete head-to-toe figures. No cropping. Every figure equal height and aligned footbaseline. Truly transparent RGBA, opaque figures, clean antialiased edges. NO ground shadows, lights, colored halos, smoke, texture or stray dots. No text or cell borders. Nonpixel 2D illustration.
